chapter.verse: Nang na hihleh thuhilhna kilekkim tawh a kituakin pulak in.
Khangham pasalte pen lungsim a tei sinsen, gamtatzia a zahtak-huai, ngaihsut a thulam tawn, upna, itna leh thuakzawhna cihte ah a kilekkim hiding uh hi.
Tua mah bangin khangham numeite in zong biakna mite' gamtat luhekzia nei ding uh a, kuamah gendai lo, lengtui sila suakkha lo-in thuhoih hilh ding uh hi.
Khanglai numeite lamlak ding uh a, tua tungtawnin a pasalte uh leh a tate uh a it,
ngaihsut a thulam tawn, nuntak a siangtho, innsungna a zo, a thunuam, a pasalte' kiangah amau' thu-in a niamlut, hong hi uh hileh Pasian' thu zong mindai lo pah ding hi.
Tua mah bangin khanglai pasalte zong ngaihsut a thulam tawn ahih nading uh thapia in.
Na khempeuh ah nangmahmah nahoih sepna etteh lim ahi dingin om inla, na thuhilhna ah thumaan cihtakna, vang etlawm, leh
mite' mawhmat theihloh ding thugen kilekkim, cihte lakkhia in. Tua hileh i langte khatpeuh in ei tawh kisai thusia a genkik theih om lo ding a, amahmah maizum lel ding hi.
Silate pen na khempeuh ah amau' tote' kiangah a niamlut ding uh ahi hi. Nialhat lo-in a pahtak-huai hiding uh a,
khutsim thei lo-in muanhuaina a hoih a cingtaak lakkhia ding uh hi. Tua hileh na khempeuh ah eite' Honpa Pasian' thuhilhna a pahtawi hiding uh hi.
A hang pen Pasian' hehpihna hong kilang khinzo a, mi khempeuh' tungah hotkhiatna hong tun khinzo hi.

Kihtakbei gamtatna leh leitung cilesa lunggulhnate i nusiat nading ahi zongin, hih khanghun sungah ngaihsut a thulam tawn, a thutang, biakna lungsim tawh a nungta i hih nading ahi zongin, tua hehpihna in eite hong sek hi.
Eite zong i lametna thupha ahi, i Pasian a lianpi leh Honpa Jesu Khris ii minpha hong kilatkik ding ngakin i om hi.

Tua Jesu Khris in thukhun pampaihna namkim pan eite hong tatkhiat theih nadingin leh nahoih sep ding a thalawp, ama' neihtuam mipawl dingin hong siansuah theih nadingin amahmah eite' taangin hong kipiakhia hi.
Hih thu genkhia in. Thuneihna khempeuh zangin thapia inla khialhna laktel in. Kuamah kisimmawhsak kei in.
